name: Varmora Granito Limited
description: We offer a diverse range of products comprising high-quality, durable and aesthetic tiles, including glazed vitrified tiles, polished vitrified tiles and ceramic tiles. As of March 31, 2025, our product portfolio included over 3,500 stock-keeping units for tiles across 20 different surface types, which address different use cases such as flooring, walls, back paneling, façade and kitchen slabs. We sell our products through a multi-channel distribution network comprising business-to-consumer retail channels and business-to-business channels.
